description:
After-sales ACTION REQUEST on one of YOUR orders (scope aftersales:request). Submit-only unless noted: nothing runs without the human's Passkey; on approval the server re-checks and runs the real order route.

- action="confirm_receipt": a delivered Direct Pay order is confirmed at once only if the owner allowed AI confirms, within that cap, nothing open; else (and USDC escrow) a refusal with order_url. Game currency: also received_amount.
- action="report_listing" | "report_receipt" (game currency; at once, no approval): stage + time_left_display; received_amount. A short report_receipt opens a problem; seller and owner are told.
- action="update_info" (game currency; at once; owner told): expected_revision + listed_at | time_left_display | stage.
- action="cancel" (Direct Pay only, unpaid window/negotiation/expired-grace): zero funds move.
- action="request_return" (completed, in the return window; not_received / wrong_item also within 7 days of an AI confirm; not_received returns nothing): the seller decides.
- The response carries the economic_effect the human will see. One active request per (order, action): same content reuses it, changed content = conflict with its id. Disputes / refunds: human only.

time_left_display.description: Exactly as the game shows it

name: webaz_buyer_action_request
